name: Caravin Silk — Traveling Merchant
description: A gnome merchant who runs a painted wagon along the Northreach circuit — Waystone to Welton to Pinebrook to Palebank and back. Caravin has an eye for unusual goods, a gift for gossip, and a complete unwillingness to explain where certain items came from. His prices are negotiable but his starting point is aggressive. He appears roughly every 3–4 weeks unless the roads are bad, in which case he appears whenever he feels like it.
notes: Caravin's stock rotates — not everything here is always available. Roll or choose 1d6+4 items from the list as current stock. He responds well to Persuasion (DC 12 for 10% discount, DC 16 for 20%). He always knows one useful rumor; it costs 5gp or a drink.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.priceNote: Above market; he knows you need it
items.notes: 2–3 vials at most. 'Supply and demand, friend.'

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.notes: One vial. He won't say where it came from.

items.name: Spell Scroll (2nd level)
items.notes: Ask Caravin what spells are available. He usually has 1–2.

items.name: Dust of Disappearance
items.notes: One small pouch. 'Very limited supply, very unlimited usefulness.'

items.name: Fine Wine (Solaris vintage)
items.notes: One case (6 bottles). 'For special occasions only. Or Tuesdays.'

items.name: Map, local area
items.notes: Caravin sells route maps of varying accuracy. Some are genuinely useful.

items.name: Rumor (current)
items.notes: Caravin always has one good rumor. Price is a drink or 5gp.

items.name: Aeorian Trinket
items.notes: Small object of uncertain origin. Faintly warm to the touch. Detect Magic shows a faint transmutation aura. What it does — if anything — is unknown.
